questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mangoes are grapes.

All grapes are guavas.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some guavas are mangoes.

II. All mangoes are guavas.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adf9f44a2164d5dde5aefdf83824de1140b1a847d92e93bc93b4e10c1914de01.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some guavas are mangoes → Follow (As all mangoes are grapes and all grapes are guavas. As whole mangoes comes in grapes which whole comes in guavas, therefore it is true.)

II. All mangoes are guavas → Follow (As all mangoes are grapes and all grapes are guavas. As whole mangoes comes in grapes which whole comes in guavas, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(63, 9, 27)

(105, 15, 45)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Logic: 2nd number × 7 = 1st number.

2nd number × 3 = 3rd number.

Now,

For (63, 9, 27):

⇒ 9 × 7 = 63

⇒ 9 × 3 = 27

For (105, 15, 45)

⇒ 15 × 7 = 105

⇒ 15 × 3 = 45

Similarly, for **Option 3: (147, 21, 63)**

**⇒ 21 × 7 = 147**

**⇒ 21 × 3 = 63**

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As P is common on both the dices, it is clear that A, B, C, and R are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. Q will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/632f4e136299ac27cfce62aa037f5ed7d3f21a3f003333c72ed710aae36e968c.png]

B → R

A → C

questions.question: Seven children - T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. U sits second to left of Z. Y sits third to the left of T. Only one child sits to the right of X. Only two children sit to the left of W. Who among the following children sits at the extreme left end of the row?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven children - T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

1) Only two children sit to the left of W.

2) Only one child sits to the right of X. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf5f47b2604ace89cb71abbd90d5f38c1948ccacda970297cc1d23433c5090be.png] 

3) Y sits third to the left of T.

4) U sits second to left of Z.

After positioning Y, T, U and Z only one position is left which will be occupied by the only child left i.e. V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c61a291dfcd610de14025bed77c3b07ded22d03d402412c3d0f07a8617036f9.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Y among the following children sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
